pdf_requirements.threshold: g_p >= g_c; no epsilon in bit test

conventions.interpolation: float64 bilinear via horizontal lerp then vertical lerp; no intensity rounding or padding
conventions.bit_order: p0 east; counterclockwise on displayed image; p contributes 2**p
conventions.support: centre plus every nonzero-weight bilinear stencil pixel must be inside same raw ROI and image
conventions.overlap: retain shared pixels independently; no priority subtraction
conventions.missing: any required region invalid/small -> missing_C1; no 236-vector or zero-fill
conventions.histogram: uint64 counts, divide float64 by integer eligible count; no epsilon L1
conventions.nonfinite: reject image/landmarks/interpolation/histogram; no nan_to_num, imputation or clipping
conventions.dtype: float64 C1 after per-region L1; no added feature or refit A/B
conventions.new_query: same aligned 256x256 RGB input, pinned geometry/grayscale/codebook/support; explicit missing state

provenance.nri_definition: PDF; technical terminology cross-check only: scikit-image 0.25.2 documentation
provenance.backend_caveat: scikit-image rounds neighbour coordinates to 5 decimals and has its own border/interpolation arithmetic; this specification does not blindly delegate those conventions
